Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using tandem affinity purification (TAP) to identify binding partners of CUL5. While the paper discusses ubiquitylation extensively in the biological results, the MS analysis itself was used for protein-protein interaction identification, not for ubiquitylome enrichment (no diGly/K-GG search mentioned in the MS methods).

scope: tandem affinity purification followed by LC-MS/MS is employed

SBP-S-CUL5 was first affinity-purified using Streptavidin Sepharose (Thermo Fisher Scientific, 20359) and eluted with 2 mg/mL biotin in NETN buffer. The eluate was subsequently incubated with S-protein agarose (Millipore, 69704) and eluted with SDS sample buffer for SDS-PAGE and mass spectrometry analysis.
